item.title: Profile
item.description:
Current Role & Research

I am a Solution Architect at Eviden in Vienna. I received my PhD from TU Wien (Research Group Parallel Computing). My research interests remain in the High Performance Computing (HPC) area. Specifically, performance optimization of HPC applications, and profiling and performance analysis of communication libraries, MPI (Open MPI and MPICH), and NVIDIA Collective Communications Library (NCCL). My past research includes topics on interconnects, resilience, and fault tolerance.
